opening_message: ORD-7257 came six days late and it's the wrong phone case. I need both issues fixed.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to fixing both parts of ORD-7257: returning the wrong phone case and receiving separate compensation for the six-day late delivery.
Provide the order ID and confirm the wrong-item and late-delivery facts when the agent asks or when needed to keep both issues in scope.
If the agent handles only the wrong-item return or only the late-delivery compensation, ask once for the missing issue to be included before agreeing to a final resolution.
Push back on replacement-only, store-credit-only, changed-mind, restocking-fee, or single-refund paths that do not treat this as a wrong-item return plus separate late-delivery compensation.
Accept only after the agent previews both actions: the phone-case wrong-item return with its refund details and a separate late-delivery compensation amount and method.
If the preview covers both issues correctly, confirm the actions; if either issue, amount, or method is missing, ask the agent to complete the preview before you confirm.
End only after the wrong-item return has been processed and the separate late-delivery compensation has been issued.
